features.title: Dark Pact
features.description: You have forged a pact with the dark beings that lurk in the shadows of the drow civilization. Spells of darkness, poison, madness, and spite fill your mind. You might turn your powers to noble ends, but you always face the temptation to enhance your spells by hurting your friends—just a little.

features.title: Elemental Pact
features.description: The Elemental Chaos's power lured you into forging a pact with one of the inscrutable primordials. You reached into the rolling Plane Below and stole its power. Your magic is wild and random, changing to suit the powers you serve. The elemental power fueling your spells surprised your enemies with the seemingly random energy you can loose against them.

Your magic is wild and random, changing to suit the powers you serve. The elemental power fueling your spells surprised your enemies with the seemingly random energy you can loose against them.
After short or extended rest, roll a d10 to determine your current elemental affinity. You can choose the damage type when you use your second wind, but the type changes again when you rest.

On your turn, when you use an arcane attack power that deals force, necrotic, poison, or psychic damage, you can change the damage type to match that of your current elemental affinity. Your elemental affinity's damage type replaces each instance of force, necrotic, poison, and psychic damage that the power deals.
You gain the Accursed Affinity pact boon.
You gain the chromatic bolt power.

features.title: Fey Pact
features.description: You have forged a bargain with ancient, amoral powers of the Feywild. Some are primitive earth spirits, grim and menacing; some are capricious wood, sky, or water spirits; and others are incarnations of seasons or natural forces who roam the faerie realm like wild gods. They bestow magic that ranges from feral and savage to wondrous and enchanting.

features.description: Long ago a forgotten race of devils created a secret path to power and taught it to the tieflings of old to weaken their fealty to Asmodeus. In his wrath, Asmodeus destroyed the scheming devils and struck their very names from the memory of all beings—but you dare to study their perilous secrets anyway.

features.title: Eldritch Pact
features.description:
You have forged a pact with mysterious entities that grant you your arcane powers. Choose one pact. The pacts presented in the Player's Handbook are the fey pact, the infernal pact, and the star pact. Other products present additional pacts. The pact you choose determines the following Warlock abilities:
- *At-Will Spells:* Your pact determines one of the at-will spells you know.
- *Pact Boon:* Each pact includes a pact boon. The pact boon is a granted power you can use to further hex your enemies.

The pact you take also provides bonuses to certain Warlock powers. Individual powers detail the effects (if any) your Eldritch Pact selection has on them. Choose one of the following pacts:
